is: Two public modules: the commission and board nouns (elements) and the seams that store them (ports).
conventions: A new port area adds a file under `ports/` rather than growing `mod.rs`.
Time is injected, never read from the ambient clock.

fs.role: module index for elements/: commission and workflow

fs.name: elements/
fs.role: the commission aggregate and the boards

fs.role: module index for ports/, re-exports the port traits flat

fs.name: ports/
fs.role: trait seams: commission, changelog, workflow, file (FileStore); errors.rs (UnknownTab, UnknownSurface, ElementNotFound)

refs.title: The Changelog as the Only Record

notes: Adapters: `adapter-pg` implements these private-store ports, `adapter-mem` fakes them.
Changelog entries are appended in the same unit as the domain write they record, and nothing is derived from them (59310081).

`commission_element` carries a **composite** FK `(tab_id, commission_id) → commission_tab (id, commission_id)`, so an element citing another commission's tab is unwritable; `UnknownTab` is the friendly 404 half of that rule (45514754).
View grants are per-User, never per-Account; membership confers no view (29130754, amended 2026-09-04).
